verdict.rationale: Sentry's Trace Explorer supports ad hoc exploration of span samples, letting you aggregate data with "flexible queries and filters." The Issues page and dashboard widgets also offer property-based filtering and dataset visualization, and Seer Agent answers natural-language questions over telemetry. However, the pack never documents a formal query language or search syntax reference, so the "documented query language" part of the story is only implied by filter UIs. Missing for 10: a documented query language/syntax reference, coverage of ad hoc querying across logs and errors beyond spans, independent or hands-on corroboration.
